Both of these frameworks, fascism and Marxism, fail because they overemphasize. The issue is not emphasizing material conditions and class conflict or emphasizing biology and the necessity of having access to—

I think it's the Machiavellianism. Because, you know, people's lives are fucked. Of course, they need to survive. They don't care about ideology. They need bread. So let's just tell them, hey, those people, if you do this, you have the bread. And then you just have the rhetoric bigger and bigger and bigger. And then it becomes psychotic, right?

So what I would argue is I would argue that India has developed the same non-dual framework. So there are certain strains of Hinduism, like Kashmir Shaivism, which totally agrees with the Daoism.
